_meta.purpose: Competitor persona + careless/conscientious axis.  Careless/conscientious is a response-STYLE axis (modulates thoroughness, attention to detail, safety-prefacing).  Competitor is the first base-persona candidate (|μ|=0.25, n=4) for this axis -- a careless 'ship and iterate' competitor and a conscientious 'measure twice' competitor are both recognisable.  Question mix: 7 conscientious-trait planning/process prompts (where the careless pole produces shortcut answers and the conscientious pole produces step-by-step) + 3 competitor-role personality probes + 2 extraction power-questions + 2 hand-written named-tradeoff dilemmas.  Per AGENT_NOTES rule 3, the careless trait's own questions (CPR, medication dosage, electrical wiring) are deliberately EXCLUDED -- the safety prior dominates them.

hand_written: two hours to prepare for an important meeting (process prompt)
project behind schedule, ship cut version or not (named tradeoff)

design_notes: Convention: pos=conscientious (RLHF-aligned), neg=careless.  YAML sets role_from=conscientious, role_to=careless; sign=+1 steers toward careless.
RLHF mildly favors conscientious; expect slightly stronger response on careless (sign=+1) than on conscientious (sign=-1).
